name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v530: Fixed Cloudflare bypass loop - cookies now detected even when cf_clearance is HttpOnly and invisible to JavaScript. hasClearance() now checks for cf_clearance= existence instead of requiring 10+ char token. Added manual 'Force Save Cookies' button in visible mode that saves whatever cookies are in the WebView jar right now as a fallback. Better cookie domain coverage including www. variants and bare domains. All v529 features retained: cookie saved under all 8 AnimePahe hosts, cleaned UA consistency, Retry Solve button, 5 post-load check intervals, invisible WebView toggle, cookie freshness check (~30 min), probe throttle once per minute, stream-link cache ~20 min.
